explication: Salesforce Skills Library packages self-contained, executable agent workflows for Salesforce application work. A user describes a task in a compatible AI tool; the tool uses an appropriate skill’s instructions and, where provided, its scripts to carry out the workflow and return a result. The repository spans Agentforce, platform development, data and administration, and industry/service tasks. README documents broader capabilities than the sampled source shows, so those branches are represented at the skills-directory level; arrows to specific implementations are limited to supported examples.
